output.reason: [ev-49191aa49f5f] says Istio 1.24 adds a new 1.23 compatibility profile and updates the other profiles. It describes the profile as an opt-in tool for keeping older behaviour, and it sends readers to the individual change and upgrade notes for the behaviour changes themselves. The proposed statement only says operators "can apply" the profile, which is an available option, not something that works differently when the operator does nothing. So behavior-change is not supported for this item. The evidence gives no failure and no default shift caused by adding the profile, so the consequence is none (informational), and the underlying 1.24 behaviour changes belong to their own items.

correction.statement: Istio 1.24 adds an opt-in 1.23 compatibility profile and updates its other compatibility profiles to cover 1.24 changes. Operators who do nothing are not affected by this item, because the related behaviour changes are covered in their own change and upgrade notes.

consequence.statement: No operational consequence from this item: the 1.23 compatibility profile is a new opt-in option, and an operator who does not select it sees no effect from its addition. The 1.24 behaviour changes it reverts are covered by separate change notes.
